title: Evening jots and errands
content:
Evening brain dump — 2026-03-13

Context:
- Quick capture of stuff I don’t want to forget before tomorrow. Mostly errands + follow-ups + tiny engineering reminders.
- Not a polished handoff, just raw notes.

WINS (today):
- Demo went OK with infra patch (reduced median latency by ~6ms in staging).
- Merged small client-side telemetry fix (PR #782).

BLOCKERS / parking lot:
- Still seeing rarer KV cache evictions on long-chat flows (stacktrace points to kv-ttl path). Opened INF-842 — need to repro with longer history.
- Console rollout flaky on Canary A (timing issue when shifting routing policy).

TOP 3 FOR TOMORROW (priority):
1) Reproduce KV eviction locally with 8k token conversation (start with loadgen script, tag logs).
2) Write short bug blurb for Canary failure and ping Alex/Suzanne.
3) Finish notes for Friday’s on-call handover (include quick restart steps).

QUICK ACTION ITEMS (tick when done):
- [ ] Run load script and collect traces (use loadgen-latest, record from 10:30–11:00)
- [ ] Add a short rollback playbook to the Console rollout doc
- [ ] Ping infra about a possible extra warmup on new Dedicated nodes

MEETING FOLLOW-UPS:
- 1:1 w/ Priya: share my rough schedule for next week; discuss coverage on Friday on-call -> send calendar invite.
- Team sync: tag INF-842 + link to repro in the thread, assign owner.

ERRANDS / PERSONAL TODOS:
- Groceries: milk, eggs, spinach, coffee beans (medium roast), bananas, oat milk
- Drop off: dry cleaning (shirt + blazer) by 6pm tomorrow
- Pick up: replacement phone charger (USB-C braided) from Target
- Health: schedule dentist appointment (call 555-0192) — prefer Tue morning
- Mail: mail the signed lease to landlord (stamp + envelope)

HOME PROJECTS (mini backlog):
- [ ] Replace living room lightbulb with daylight LED (in utility drawer)
- [ ] Test NAS backup before weekend (run quick rsync check)

SMALL NOTES TO SELF (engineering):
- If I need to flush KV in staging quickly: POST to /admin/internal/kv/flush?env=staging (remember to include X-Org header) — double-check perms.
- Useful commands:
  - tail -f /var/log/redwood/serving.log | grep "kv-evict"
  - python tools/loadgen.py --model=rw-4b --tokens=8000 --rate=5 --out=traces/kv-test-2026-03-14

IDEAS / TODO FOR LATER (non-urgent):
- Write a runbook section about batching vs latency tradeoffs for new hires (short, example-driven).
- Collect 3 short examples of prompts that cause cache blowup for the eval playbook.

RANDOM REMINDERS:
- Refill travel-size hand sanitizer in bag.
- Order new coffee filters when ordering groceries.

TOMORROW MORNING (first 30min):
- 09:00 — quick sync with SRE (10m) to confirm canary thresholds
- 09:20 — triage INF-842 logs (start reproducer)
- 09:50 — write 3-sentence summary for Priya

SHORT CHECKLIST BEFORE LEAVING OFFICE:
- [ ] Push any local branches, note PR numbers in Slack thread
- [ ] Leave a short note in the on-call doc if I’m taking PTO next Friday

END NOTES:
- If I get blocked on KV repro by noon, escalate to Alex + put a short blurb in Monday’s standup notes.
- Keep this file simple; will prune into PRs/Confluence items once I have concrete reproduction steps.
